name: dns-sync
description: Reviews DNS zone changes with dns-sync and applies them after your approval.
about: Point it at a repo that manages DNS as YAML zones with dns-sync. It validates the zones, builds a plan, and gives a SAFE, REVIEW or RISKY verdict per zone. It applies the saved plan only after you approve it in the chat, then checks for drift.
features: Validate zone files and report errors by file and line
Plan changes and rate each zone SAFE, REVIEW or RISKY
Apply the saved plan only after your approval
examplePrompt: Review the DNS changes on my branch and apply them if the plan looks safe.
